# SveltyCMS

> SveltyCMS is a database-agnostic headless CMS built with SvelteKit 3, Svelte 5 (runes), TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4. Editors manage content in the responsive admin UI; consumer apps connect via REST, GraphQL, and Server-Sent Events (SSE); server routes call the in-process LocalCMS SDK (0–2ms latency). Collections run with full feature parity across SQLite, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, and MongoDB. Supports multi-tenant isolation, hub-and-spoke multi-platform syndication, and enterprise SCIM 2.0.

The public docs are organized by reader goals and architectural layers:

## Get started

- [Getting started](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/getting-started): Install SveltyCMS and run the 5-step setup wizard.
- [Onboarding](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/onboarding): First steps after installation.
- [Setup walkthrough](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/onboarding/setup-wizard): Database selection, admin creation, blueprint seeding, and completion.
- [Persona paths](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/onboarding/persona-paths): Guided paths for editors, administrators, and developers.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/troubleshooting): Resolving localhost:5173 access, port collisions (lsof, kill-port), and common errors.

## Concepts & Comparisons

- [Concepts](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/concepts): Collection schemas, entries, widget architecture, multi-tenancy, APIs, and database adapters.
- [Headless CMS Comparison 2026](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/project/competitive-comparison): Objective comparison with Payload CMS, Strapi, and Directus under EU Directive 2006/114/EC and German UWG §6.
- [SvelteKit 3 Migration Guide](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/development/sveltekit-v3-migration): Breaking changes, process.env.ORIGIN replacement, and Svelte 5 runes conventions.

## Guides

Task-oriented recipes for editorial, administration, and deployment operations:

- [Guides Index](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/guides): Directory of task guides.
- [Collection Builder](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/guides/content/collection-builder): Visual schema designer with bidirectional code-GUI parity.
- [Workflows & Syndication](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/guides/content/workflows): Draft, review, publish, and corporate multi-platform brand governance.
- [Automations](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/guides/content/automations): Event-driven triggers, webhooks, cron schedules, and agentic tasks.
- [E-commerce](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/guides/content/ecommerce): Product catalogs, orders, and payment integrations.
- [Image Editor](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/guides/content/image-editor): Non-destructive in-browser Canvas editing and Sharp.js transforms.
- [Migration & Import](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/guides/content/migration-and-import): Moving content from WordPress, Strapi, or flat files.
- [Access Management](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/guides/configuration/access-management): RBAC, permissions, and session policies.
- [Email System](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/guides/configuration/email-system): Svelte email templates with Tailwind CSS inlining and SMTP.
- [Production Deployment](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/guides/deployment/production-deployment): Docker and Node.js production hosting.
- [Vercel Deployment](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/guides/deployment/vercel-deployment): Serverless deployment with remote PostgreSQL / MongoDB and S3 storage.
- [GDPR Compliance](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/guides/legal/gdpr-compliance): Automated Right to Erasure, Data Portability, and cryptographic audit logs.

## Build & Extend

- [Development Index](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/development): Extending SveltyCMS.
- [Native UI Primitives](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/development/ui): AdminPageShell, AdminCard, Button, and theme tokens.
- [Custom Widgets](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/development/widgets): Creating custom field widgets with schema, input, and display layers.
- [Local SDK vs HTTP](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/development/local-vs-http-api): Performance benchmarks and architectural guidance for LocalCMS.
- [Site Starter](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/development/site-starter): Built-in public website template.
- [Plugins System](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/development/plugins/development): Server hooks, capabilities, and encrypted settings.

## Reference

- [Reference Index](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/reference): Technical reference hub.
- [API Reference](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/reference/api): REST, GraphQL, and Remote Functions.
- [SCIM 2.0 User Provisioning](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/reference/api/scim): RFC 7644 enterprise IdP integration (Okta, Entra ID).
- [Real-Time Updates](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/reference/api/graphql-subscriptions): Server-Sent Events (SSE) and Yjs CRDT collaboration.
- [Security Architecture](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/reference/security): CSP, field-level access control, and Passkeys/WebAuthn.
- [Database Adapters](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/reference/database): Strict agnosticism across SQLite, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, and MongoDB.
- [Multi-Tenancy Architecture](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/reference/architecture/multi-tenancy): Cross-tenant syndication, draft airgaps, and channel constraints.
- [Live Preview Architecture](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/reference/architecture/live-preview-architecture): Cryptographic handshake and iframe visual editing.

## Contribute

- [Validation Pipeline](https://docs.sveltycms.com/docs/contributing/validation-pipeline): Pre-commit git hooks, linting, and CI gates.

## Machine-Readable Extras

- [OpenAPI Spec](https://demo.sveltycms.com/api/openapi.json): Live generated schema.
- [MCP Knowledge Server](https://mcp.sveltycms.com/mcp): Model Context Protocol endpoints for AI agent tool integration.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/SveltyCMS/SveltyCMS): Open-source source code and issue tracker.
- [Marketplace](https://marketplace.sveltycms.com): Community widgets, plugins, and themes.
